prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1002; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Going forward, all communications regarding this claim, including requests for statements, scheduling, or settlement discussions, should be directed exclusively to this firm and not to our client.

We also request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver and the policy declarations page confirming those limits. Please identify any other coverage that may apply, including umbrella or excess policies.

In addition, we ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file notes, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any surveillance footage. Please ensure that no vehicle or component is repaired, altered, or disposed of without notice to this office so that we may arrange an appropriate inspection.
